title: momentum — autocracy

phrases.translation: 动量守恒；动量不变原理

sentences.sentence: incentives to maintain the momentum of European integration
sentences.translation: 保持欧洲一体化发展势头的激励措施

sentences.sentence: Governments often lose momentum in their second term of office.
sentences.translation: 政府往往会在第二届任期中丧失冲劲。

sentences.sentence: Garlic aids in the digestion of fats and oils, lowers blood pressure, prevents arteriosclerosis, and lowers cholesterol levels.
sentences.translation: 大蒜具有帮助消化脂肪和油脂，降低血压，防止动脉硬化和降低固醇水平的功能。

sentences.sentence: If this high concentration of blood sugar continues for a long period, it will affect the vascular system and cause serious diseases including arteriosclerosis and retinal hemorrhages.
sentences.translation: 如果这种高血糖浓度状况持续一段长时期，将影响到血管系统并导致包括动脉硬化和视网膜出血在内的严重疾病。

sentences.sentence: Finally, lower your daily intake of salt, which will minimize your risk of arteriosclerosis.
sentences.translation: 最后，每天减少盐的摄入量，可以减小动脉硬化的危险。

translations.translation: 动物群, 动物区系, 动物志

sentences.sentence: ...the flora and fauna of the African jungle.
sentences.translation: …非洲丛林的植物群和动物群。

sentences.sentence: Hey, Beethoven: Get a full-time job, a part-time business, a spouse, a few kids, and a menagerie of pets and wait till you see how many symphonies you can crank out!
sentences.translation: 嘿，贝多芬：找到一个全职工作，兼职经商，一个配偶，几个孩子，和一个动物园的宠物，然后等待看你能够制造出多少交响乐。

sentences.sentence: The coffers were filled not only with the standard treasures and artifacts but a menagerie of wild African animals including ostriches and giraffes to be sent back to the emperor.
sentences.translation: 这样，船队中不只是装着金银珠宝和工艺品，还有小型动物园，里面有来自非洲的动物，如鸵鸟和长颈鹿都被带到南京，敬献给皇帝。

sentences.sentence: The 18-year-old studied animal management before taking a full-time role looking after her parents giant menagerie which houses more than 120 animals.
sentences.translation: 这个18岁的女孩在她父母豢养了超过120只动物的大动物园里全职工作，在此之前，她学习动物管理学。

translations.translation: 动摇, 开始退让, 踌躇, 挥动者

phrases.translation: 共振腔；空腔谐振器，呼吸腔

sentences.sentence: Put herbs inside the body cavity of the fish.
sentences.translation: 把香草放进鱼肚里。

sentences.sentence: I have no cavities (= no holes in my teeth ) .
sentences.translation: 我没有蛀牙洞。

phrases.translation: 空心混凝土；多孔混凝土；大孔隙混凝土
话听起来不诚恳；话语听着空洞
混凝土空心砌块；空心混凝土砖；水泥空心砖

sentences.sentence: Normally timid, they rarely stray far from their burrows.
sentences.translation: 它们通常很胆小，极少远离自己的洞穴。

translations.translation: 洞穴, 岩穴, 人工洞室

sentences.sentence: Water trickles through an underground grotto.
sentences.translation: 水流经一个地下岩洞。

sentences.sentence: His interest in the kindred field of speleology was promptly revived.
sentences.translation: 他感兴趣的领域的骨肉洞穴学的迅速恢复。

sentences.sentence: Apparently sensitive to criticism，the bull forgot all about the matador and charged at the drunk.
sentences.translation: 那公牛显然对批评话是敏感的，所以它把斗牛士全忘记了，向那醉汉冲了过去。

sentences.sentence: They liked his emotion at the table, the undisguised fire and grief; they fell for his murmuring, boyish charm, and most of all they admired the matador beauty of his play.
sentences.translation: 人们喜欢球桌旁真情流露毫不掩饰的他，喜欢他的喃喃自语，他的男孩般迷人魅力，更多的人则欣赏他在比赛中斗牛士般辛辣的美。

sentences.sentence: Even the bull seemed to feel sorry for him, for it looked on sympathetically until the drunk was out of the way before once more turning its attention to the matador.
sentences.translation: 好像连牛也在为他感到遗憾，因为它一直同情地看着醉汉，直到他的背影消逝，才重新将注意力转向斗牛士。

translations.translation: 斗蓬, 覆盖物, 壁炉架

phrases.translation: 地函对流，地幔对流；地幔对流

sentences.sentence: The parks and squares looked grim under a mantle of soot and ash.
sentences.translation: 在一层烟尘的笼罩下，这些公园和广场显得阴沉沉的。

translations.translation: 斗争, 冲突, 竞争

sentences.sentence: Money is a major cause of strife in many marriages.
sentences.translation: 钱在许多婚姻中是导致冲突的一个主要原因。

sentences.sentence: He looked up at me through a miasma of cigarette smoke.
sentences.translation: 他在香烟烟雾中抬头看着我。

sentences.sentence: A foul miasma lay over the town.
sentences.translation: 一阵难闻的瘴气笼罩在小镇的上空。

sentences.sentence: Henry looked up, then continued his monologue.
sentences.translation: 亨利抬起头，然后继续他的长篇独白。

sentences.sentence: But this view misses the dark side of the bargain we made with the autocrat: we befriended him but enraged his population.
sentences.translation: 但是这一观点忽略了我们美国与独裁者交易的黑暗一面：我们照顾独裁者但是却激怒了人民。

sentences.sentence: Its last monarch, Shah Reza Pahlavi, was overthrown in 1979, but he was replaced by yet another autocrat, the Ayatollah Khomeini.
sentences.translation: 1979年，其最后的君主，沙阿 礼萨 巴拉维被推翻，但取代他的却是另外一个独裁者，阿亚图拉 霍梅尼。

sentences.sentence: This love of home, the desire to retrieve the country from the grip of the autocrat and his retainers, was what animated a hitherto submissive population.
sentences.translation: 是对祖国的热爱和将祖国从独裁者及其走狗的魔爪中夺回的热望鼓舞着温和顺从的人民走上的起义的道路。

translations.translation: 独裁者, 独裁政权执政者, 口授令他人笔录者

sentences.sentence: the downfall of the hated dictator
sentences.translation: 遭人痛恨的独裁者的垮台

translations.translation: 独裁政治, 独裁政府

sentences.sentence: Many poor countries are abandoning autocracy.
sentences.translation: 很多贫穷国家都在推翻独裁统治。

text:
英语词汇 · GRE · 第 156 单元

momentum
音标：英 /mə'mentəm/  美 /mo'mɛntəm/
n. 动力, 要素
短语：angular momentum — [化]角动量
短语：momentum equation — 动量方程
短语：momentum conservation — 动量守恒
短语：momentum transfer — 动量传递；动量交换
短语：conservation of momentum — 动量守恒；动量不变原理
短语：momentum flux — 动量通量
短语：linear momentum — 线动量；线动量陀螺仪
短语：gain momentum — 发展加快；势头增大
短语：orbital angular momentum — 轨道角动量
短语：momentum balance — 动量平衡
短语：momentum theory — 动量理论
短语：moment of momentum — 动量矩；角动量
短语：momentum integral — 动量积分
短语：momentum coefficient — 动量系数
例句：incentives to maintain the momentum of European integration
保持欧洲一体化发展势头的激励措施
例句：Governments often lose momentum in their second term of office.
政府往往会在第二届任期中丧失冲劲。

arteriosclerosis
音标：英 /ɑː,tɪərɪəʊsklɪə'rəʊsɪs; -sklə-/  美 /ɑr,tɪriosklə'rosɪs/
n. 动脉硬化
短语：cerebral arteriosclerosis — 脑动脉硬化
例句：Garlic aids in the digestion of fats and oils, lowers blood pressure, prevents arteriosclerosis, and lowers cholesterol levels.
大蒜具有帮助消化脂肪和油脂，降低血压，防止动脉硬化和降低固醇水平的功能。
例句：If this high concentration of blood sugar continues for a long period, it will affect the vascular system and cause serious diseases including arteriosclerosis and retinal hemorrhages.
如果这种高血糖浓度状况持续一段长时期，将影响到血管系统并导致包括动脉硬化和视网膜出血在内的严重疾病。
例句：Finally, lower your daily intake of salt, which will minimize your risk of arteriosclerosis.
最后，每天减少盐的摄入量，可以减小动脉硬化的危险。

fauna
音标：英 /'fɔːnə/  美 /'fɔnə/
n. 动物群, 动物区系, 动物志
短语：flora and fauna — 动植物；动植物群
例句：...the flora and fauna of the African jungle.
…非洲丛林的植物群和动物群。

menagerie
音标：英 /mə'nædʒ(ə)rɪ/  美 /mə'nædʒəri/
n. 动物园, 动物展览
例句：Hey, Beethoven: Get a full-time job, a part-time business, a spouse, a few kids, and a menagerie of pets and wait till you see how many symphonies you can crank out!
嘿，贝多芬：找到一个全职工作，兼职经商，一个配偶，几个孩子，和一个动物园的宠物，然后等待看你能够制造出多少交响乐。
例句：The coffers were filled not only with the standard treasures and artifacts but a menagerie of wild African animals including ostriches and giraffes to be sent back to the emperor.
这样，船队中不只是装着金银珠宝和工艺品，还有小型动物园，里面有来自非洲的动物，如鸵鸟和长颈鹿都被带到南京，敬献给皇帝。
例句：The 18-year-old studied animal management before taking a full-time role looking after her parents giant menagerie which houses more than 120 animals.
这个18岁的女孩在她父母豢养了超过120只动物的大动物园里全职工作，在此之前，她学习动物管理学。

perturbation
音标：英 /,pɜːtə'beɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,pɝtɚ'beʃən/
n. 动摇, 混乱
短语：perturbation method — [化]微扰法，微扰理论
短语：perturbation theory — 微扰理论；摄动理论
短语：perturbation equation — 扰荡方程，扰动方程

waver
音标：英 /'weɪvə/  美 /'wevɚ/
n. 动摇, 开始退让, 踌躇, 挥动者

cavity
音标：英 /'kævɪtɪ/  美 /'kævəti/
n. 洞, 空穴, [解剖]腔
短语：oral cavity — n. 口腔
短语：nasal cavity — 鼻腔
短语：abdominal cavity — 腹腔
短语：mold cavity — 模穴；铸模型腔；结晶苹
短语：pelvic cavity — 骨盆腔，盆腔
短语：die cavity — 刚模穴；阴模
短语：resonant cavity — 共振腔；空腔谐振器，呼吸腔
短语：shrinkage cavity — 缩孔
短语：body cavity — 体腔
短语：cavity pressure — 空腔压力
短语：cavity die — 阴模；型腔模
短语：thoracic cavity — [解]胸腔
短语：peritoneal cavity — 腹腔；腹膜腔
短语：mouth cavity — 口腔
短语：cylindrical cavity — 筒形腔；圆柱形谐振腔
短语：progressive cavity pump — 螺杆泵；螺杆抽油泵
短语：uterine cavity — 子宫腔
短语：cavity wall — 空心墙
短语：optical cavity — 光学共振器；光共振腔
短语：marrow cavity — 骨髓腔
例句：Put herbs inside the body cavity of the fish.
把香草放进鱼肚里。
例句：I have no cavities (= no holes in my teeth ) .
我没有蛀牙洞。

hollow
音标：英 /'hɒləʊ/  美 /'hɑlo/
n. 洞, 窟窿, 山谷
短语：hollow fiber — 中空纤维
短语：hollow glass — 中空玻璃；凹窝载玻片
短语：hollow block — 空心块，空心砖
短语：hollow cylinder — 空心圆柱体
短语：hollow shaft — 管轴，空心轴
短语：hollow concrete — 空心混凝土；多孔混凝土；大孔隙混凝土
短语：hollow brick — 空心砖
短语：hollow cathode — 中空阴极，空心阴极
短语：hollow sphere — 空心球体
短语：hollow steel — 中空钢
短语：ring hollow — 话听起来不诚恳；话语听着空洞
短语：hollow out — vt. 挖空（挖洞；开凿）
短语：hollow tree — 空心树
短语：concrete hollow block — 混凝土空心砌块；空心混凝土砖；水泥空心砖
短语：hollow organ — 中空瀑；中空器官
短语：hollow pipe — 空心管
短语：hollow core — 中空心
短语：hollow beam — 空心梁
短语：hollow section — 空心截面；空心型钢

burrow
音标：英 /'bʌrəʊ/  美 /'bɝro/
n. 洞穴
短语：burrow into — 探查
例句：Normally timid, they rarely stray far from their burrows.
它们通常很胆小，极少远离自己的洞穴。

grotto
音标：英 /'grɒtəʊ/  美 /'ɡrɑto/
n. 洞穴, 岩穴, 人工洞室
例句：Water trickles through an underground grotto.
水流经一个地下岩洞。

speleology
n. 洞穴学
例句：His interest in the kindred field of speleology was promptly revived.
他感兴趣的领域的骨肉洞穴学的迅速恢复。

matador
音标：英 /'mætədɔː/  美 /'mætədɔr/
n. 斗牛士
例句：Apparently sensitive to criticism，the bull forgot all about the matador and charged at the drunk.
那公牛显然对批评话是敏感的，所以它把斗牛士全忘记了，向那醉汉冲了过去。
例句：They liked his emotion at the table, the undisguised fire and grief; they fell for his murmuring, boyish charm, and most of all they admired the matador beauty of his play.
 人们喜欢球桌旁真情流露毫不掩饰的他，喜欢他的喃喃自语，他的男孩般迷人魅力，更多的人则欣赏他在比赛中斗牛士般辛辣的美。
例句：Even the bull seemed to feel sorry for him, for it looked on sympathetically until the drunk was out of the way before once more turning its attention to the matador.
好像连牛也在为他感到遗憾，因为它一直同情地看着醉汉，直到他的背影消逝，才重新将注意力转向斗牛士。

mantle
音标：英 /'mænt(ə)l/  美 /'mæntl/
n. 斗蓬, 覆盖物, 壁炉架
短语：upper mantle — 上地幔；上部地函
短语：mantle plume — [地质]地幔柱
短语：mantle convection — 地函对流，地幔对流；地幔对流
短语：lower mantle — 下地幔
短语：mantle rock — 表岩层；风化层
短语：earth mantle — 地函，地幔
例句：The parks and squares looked grim under a mantle of soot and ash.
在一层烟尘的笼罩下，这些公园和广场显得阴沉沉的。 

strife
音标：英 /straɪf/  美 /straɪf/
n. 斗争, 冲突, 竞争
短语：internal strife — 内讧；萧墙之祸；内乱
例句：Money is a major cause of strife in many marriages.
钱在许多婚姻中是导致冲突的一个主要原因。

miasma
音标：英 /mɪ'æzmə; maɪ-/  美 /maɪ'æzmɚ/
n. 毒气, 沼气
例句：He looked up at me through a miasma of cigarette smoke.
他在香烟烟雾中抬头看着我。
例句：A foul miasma lay over the town.
一阵难闻的瘴气笼罩在小镇的上空。

bane
音标：英 /beɪn/  美 /ben/
n. 毒药, 祸害

monologue
音标：英 /'mɒn(ə)lɒg/  美 /'mɑnəlɔɡ/
n. 独白, 独脚戏
短语：interior monologue — n. 内心独白
例句：Henry looked up, then continued his monologue.
亨利抬起头，然后继续他的长篇独白。

autocrat
音标：英 /'ɔːtəkræt/  美 /'ɔtəkræt/
n. 独裁者
例句：But this view misses the dark side of the bargain we made with the autocrat: we befriended him but enraged his population.
但是这一观点忽略了我们美国与独裁者交易的黑暗一面：我们照顾独裁者但是却激怒了人民。
例句：Its last monarch, Shah Reza Pahlavi, was overthrown in 1979, but he was replaced by yet another autocrat, the Ayatollah Khomeini.
1979年，其最后的君主，沙阿 礼萨 巴拉维被推翻，但取代他的却是另外一个独裁者，阿亚图拉 霍梅尼。
例句：This love of home, the desire to retrieve the country from the grip of the autocrat and his retainers, was what animated a hitherto submissive population.
是对祖国的热爱和将祖国从独裁者及其走狗的魔爪中夺回的热望鼓舞着温和顺从的人民走上的起义的道路。

dictator
音标：英 /dɪk'teɪtə/  美 /'dɪktetɚ/
n. 独裁者, 独裁政权执政者, 口授令他人笔录者
例句：the downfall of the hated dictator
遭人痛恨的独裁者的垮台

autocracy
音标：英 /ɔː'tɒkrəsɪ/  美 /ɔ'tɑkrəsi/
n. 独裁政治, 独裁政府
例句：Many poor countries are abandoning autocracy.
很多贫穷国家都在推翻独裁统治。
